hero.title: We make beauty impossible to ignore.
hero.subtitle: GiDieL is a promotion studio for cosmetics brands. From product launches to in-store activations and influencer campaigns, we turn shelves into stories and browsers into buyers.

services.title: Promotion, end to end.
services.subtitle: Every service is built around one goal: moving your cosmetics off the shelf and into baskets. Pick a single activation or let us run the whole campaign.

about.title: A promotion studio built for cosmetics.
about.subtitle: We started GiDieL because beauty brands deserve promotion that understands the counter, the creator, and the customer. For a decade we've helped colour, skincare, and fragrance labels launch, relaunch, and sell through.

pillars.title: Beauty-first thinking
pillars.description: We treat every campaign like an editorial. Aesthetics are not a layer — they are the strategy.

pillars.title: Shelf-obsessed
pillars.description: Impressions are nice. Sell-through is the metric we optimise for, every single time.

pillars.title: Embedded partnership
pillars.description: We work like an in-house promo team, not an outside vendor handing over a deck.

items.quote: GiDieL turned our spring launch into the best-selling SKU of the quarter. The in-store activation alone paid for the whole campaign.
